name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: A drop zone with a browse button and the list of chosen files, with size and type checks.

examples.name: file-upload-demo
examples.title: File upload
examples.description: Several files, limited by type and size; the hint is generated from both.

examples.name: file-upload-with-progress
examples.title: Progress and errors
examples.description: Pass FileUploadEntry objects to show upload progress, a finished state, or a per-file error.

examples.name: file-upload-single
examples.title: Single file
examples.description: Without allowsMultiple a new file replaces the current one. Prompt copy is customisable.

examples.name: file-upload-invalid
examples.title: Invalid and disabled
examples.description: A field-level error, and a disabled upload.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label; also names the drop zone and the file list.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the drop zone, linked to the browse button.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Field-level error, shown under the drop zone when isInvalid is true.

props.name: acceptedFileTypes
props.description: MIME types or extensions, e.g. ['image/*', '.pdf']. Filters the file dialog; dropped files that don't match are rejected with a message.

props.name: allowsMultiple
props.description: Allow more than one file. Without it a new file replaces the current one.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum bytes per file. Larger files are rejected with a message. Sizes display 1024-based (1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes).

props.name: files
props.description: Controlled list. FileUploadEntry = { file, progress?: 0–100, error?: string } adds a progress bar, an "Uploaded" state at 100, or an error.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the full list of accepted files after every add or remove.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with files that were refused: { file, reason: 'type' | 'size' | 'count', message }.

props.name: hint
props.description: Text under the prompt. Defaults to the accepted types and max size, e.g. "PNG, PDF, up to 10 MB".

props.name: dropLabel
props.description: Prompt text before the browse link.

props.name: browseLabel
props.description: Text of the browse link that opens the file dialog.

keyboard.action: Focuses the drop zone, then the browse button, then each file's remove button.
Drops the item being dragged with keyboard drag and drop.
Removes that file (or dismisses a rejected one).

notes: The drop zone is labelled by the field label; the browse button is described by the hint, description and error.
Rejected files are listed with their reason in a role="alert" so the refusal is announced.
Upload progress is a labelled progressbar ("Uploading invoice.pdf"); finished and failed files show an icon and text, not colour alone.
Remove buttons are named per file ("Remove invoice.pdf").

do: State accepted types and the size limit up front (the default hint does this).
Show progress and a clear per-file error with a way to remove and retry.
Validate again on the server — the client checks are for fast feedback, not security.
dont: Don't make the drop zone the only way in — keep the browse button.
Don't silently drop files that fail a check — say why.
